items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: You know like if that had happened to Count Basie group I would think many of the musicians would be keying in to where is the bass player going.

ctx.x: Yeah, and then all the music got stuck on the train and we didn’t have no music now we have to play the gig without the music. So we played it. So it was a different gig because we had to play by memory everything. Ain’t but so much you can remember on Sun Ra’s tunes. You might remember the first introductions and the basic number but all the rest of the stuff in between you don’t know who or what, what, what, what. So we’d have to go on anyway. So we played all evening without one piece of music because the…

Was the role of the bass player different from an average band like Count Basie? You know like if that had happened to Count Basie group I would think many of the musicians would be keying in to where is the bass player going. That will help me to remember my part?
Yeah. You listen to the bass, yeah of course. Because each part — but when he changed you’ve got to change too. You see? So you’re listening to that and it’s not just one thing.
